title: Wood2 Solo #33 (목재 솔로 · bubinga · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Latina · 메이크업 비닐 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 대리석 홀 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail balayage hair — full body pinkish-red bubinga wood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING pinkish-red bubinga grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID purple vein lines running between the carved sections, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing tall, arms crossed under her bust, chin raised, looking down at the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots carved from the same bubinga wood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, carved from the same bubinga wood with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-black wet-look eyeshadow with a blinding chrome highlight across the lids, a thick graphic black liner, razor-sleek lashes, liquid mirror-gloss black vinyl lips reflecting the light, a razor-sharp cool contour.

Background: a bright grand hall with a pale marble floor, tall columns, standard-height arched doors and soft golden daylight through high windows, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
